_about: Look of every outdoor scene (scripts/world/day_night.gd): warm low sun against a cool blue ambient, soft shadows, filmic AgX tone, glow, distance haze plus light valley mist, and the screen effects each graphics preset turns on. Visual tuning only; no gameplay reads it.

sun._about: elevation: the sun's height is scaled by this (1 = the old high noon sun, lower = longer, warmer light). warmth: how far day sun colours are pulled towards warm_color.

ambient._about: A cool blue fill: sky_contribution < 1 mixes in color, so shadows read blue against the warm sun.

haze._about: Exponential distance fog (all presets) and the valley's height mist (fog_height).

volumetric._about: Volumetric fog (medium: coarse and short; high: finer, longer, lit by SDFGI). density is thin on purpose: a light valley mist, not a wall.

sdfgi._about: On this Intel UHD, SDFGI reading the sky lit characters and trees chrome-white (dynamic objects read the sky through its probes). So SDFGI bounces the sun and two cool, shadowless sky_fill lights instead: one from straight above, one from the sky opposite the sun (energy = sky_fill × the hour's ambient energy, split between them). Re-check on the target machine.

presets._about: What each graphics preset (Settings.quality) turns on.
